title: Empirica observer: a page of runs (GET /api/runs, GET /api/search)
description: At most 200 one-line rows in page order (standing precedence; inside each bucket its declared order, the summary's orders: the needs-a-human bucket the oldest question first, as the summary's needs, every other bucket the most recent activity first; an untimed run after every timed one; then key), the total the filter or query admits, and the cursor of the next page (null on the last).

pending.description: Runs not read yet: not in any page.

unsearched.description: Runs whose claims were not read, so a query could not search their claim text.

id.description: A run's compact id: the first hex digits of the sha256 of its key (application.observer_index.short_id).

standing.description: The one word a run is filed under (core.observer.standing), in precedence order: unreadable (not read in full), needs_human, audit_pending, changed_since_audit, not_ended, proven, then the stop's status.

ask.description: What a human is asked about an active run (core.observer.ask), read from the item the core presents; null when nothing is asked or the run was not read.

asked_at.description: Seconds since the epoch (UTC) of the write that recorded the question, from the run's timeline (ADR-0070): a label (unsigned, may skew), and the needs-a-human bucket's order (the summary's orders: the oldest first); null when unknown.

updated.description: Seconds since the epoch (UTC) of the write that recorded the run's current state, from its timeline (ADR-0070): a label (unsigned, may skew), and every other bucket's order (the summary's orders: the most recent activity first); null when unknown.

next.description: The cursor of the next page in this view (the view's mark, then after the last row), or null on the last page.

token.description: The published view this page was cut from (the summary's token). A cursor is valid only in it: after any change a request with an older cursor is answered 409 with the current token, and the walk restarts.
